evidence.quote: Duration of the program: This is a 3.5-year program consisting of 7 academic semesters.
Language requirements: All courses are taught in English; therefore, a B2 level English proficiency is required.
The tuition fee is 7,500 USD / year for this program.
The following documents need to be submitted during the application procedure by all applicants through our online application platform
The language proficiency of applicants must be proven with a standardized, at least intermediate (B2) level language certificate, obtained at a proctored exam.
a TOEFL test with a minimum score of 513 (Paper-Based). an IELTS test with a minimum score of 5.5.

note.fr: Admission requires a high school certificate and passing entrance exams in Mathematics and Physics.
note.en: Admission requires a high school certificate and passing entrance exams in Mathematics and Physics.

notes: The quoted fee is in USD, not EUR or HUF; it is the fee the programme's own page states for this programme. An institution-wide tuition table also lists Mechanical Engineering * 7 semesters 7,500 USD/year. The application deadline '15th June' carries no year, so it is recorded as a recurring deadline; the page also says the programme starts in September of each year. The entrance exam requirement is recorded as a manual_check because the pages do not state numeric grade thresholds.
